brief: Searches texts by meaning: each text is stored with an embedding and a query returns the closest ones by cosine score.
detail: Texts are embedded when they are added, with whatever sentence-embedding model the engine holds (AddText), or the caller brings the vectors (AddEmbedded). Vectors are kept resident in the engine so a search crosses only the query. The search is exact, not approximate, and the reported score is the cosine for unit vectors. SearchByVectorXT needs no model at all; Search and Closest embed the query text, so they need one. Call Close when done.
